source.title: LiDAR Surveys and Flood Mapping of Maragondon River
source.publisher: UP Training Center for Applied Geodesy and Photogrammetry, University of the Philippines Diliman

lidarValidationSurvey.meaning: Survey-length context; not a channel boundary or named river total length.

bathymetricSurvey.sourceReportedToward: River mouth in Barangay Sapang I
bathymetricSurvey.meaning: Partial bathymetric survey coverage; not a full-river geometry.

figureReview.finding: The figure gives regional survey context and portrays a partial bathymetric extent and LiDAR validation locations. It does not provide a GIS feature, vertex list, coordinate schedule for the river route, or a defensible full-channel line.
figureReview.captionLegendMismatch: The caption describes a blue line and red survey extent, while the legend labels blue bathymetric points and red LiDAR validation points. Do not digitize the symbolized map as a precise channel trace.
figureReview.localityCaveat: The report calls Sapang I part of the Municipality of Maragondon. DENR's 2025 Gapan Adopt-a-Waterbody notice identifies Sapang I as a Ternate signatory locality. The locality descriptions conflict; no correction or crosswalk is inferred.

qualityAndReuse.documentNotice: The report states its text may be copied and distributed for research and educational purposes with proper acknowledgement.
qualityAndReuse.rawLidarOrVectorReuse: No item-specific license for redistributing raw LiDAR data or derived GIS channel geometry was established from this report notice.
qualityAndReuse.internalCopyError: The Maragondon River chapter's GNSS description says the network is for the Imus River Basin, although the surrounding section and report identify a Maragondon River survey. This appears internally inconsistent and was not used to assign river geometry.
qualityAndReuse.speciesEvidence: No fish or other species record was extracted from the reviewed survey-scope pages.

gapanCrosswalk.reason: The report describes a Maragondon River bathymetric survey ending at a mouth locality it labels Sapang I. It does not name Gapan/Gapan (Sapang) River or identify the one-kilometer Adopt-a-Waterbody segment. Shared system or barangay context is not a channel-level crosswalk.

nextAction: Retain the report as partial historical survey context for Maragondon River only. Continue seeking a permitted geospatial channel source and an official Gapan segment endpoint or station-to-channel crosswalk; do not use Figure 31 as public geometry.
